title: Resolution urging Albany to raise child care subsidy rates
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign S.1709/A.711, which would require the Office of Children and Family Services to use a cost estimation model instead of a market rate survey to set Child Care Assistance Program reimbursement rates. The Council argues current rates underpay providers, citing a study finding home-based child care workers earn a median of $6.01 per hour. About 210,000 New York households with children under six are eligible for the program.
